product.title: Fallout
product.body_html:
The Missing Link in Your Arsenal

Fallout is a purpose-built, symmetric ball designed to perfectly complement the legendary Black Widow line, and provides bowlers with a cleaner, more controlled option when larger asymmetric balls like Zero Mercy Solid start to read too early. Built around the new Aftermath core, an innovative blend of Gas Mask and Vibe influences, and wrapped in the proven HK22C² Solid cover from the Zero Mercy Solid.

BALL SPECS

  • PERFORMANCE Upper Mid
  • PART NUMBER 60-108663-93X
  • COLOR Blue / Lime / Sky Blue
  • CORE Aftermath
  • COVERSTOCK HK22C² Solid
  • COVER TYPESolid Reactive
  • FINISH 500, 2000 Siaair Micro Pad
  • WEIGHTS 16-12 Pounds
  • LANE CONDITION Medium to heavy oil
  • REACTION Strong overall hook
  • WARRANTY Two years from purchase date
  • RELEASE DATE July 16, 2026

RG / DIFF

  • 16 lb - RG (2.527) DIFF (0.045)
  • 15 lb - RG (2.520) DIFF (0.052)
  • 14 lb - RG (2.545) DIFF (0.052)
  • 13 lb - RG (2.585) DIFF (0.040)
  • 12 lb - RG (2.608) DIFF (0.040)
